answer: Agents could reserve scarce task slots by bonding a deposit that is forfeited when independent reviewers confirm fabricated work or collusive claims. A violet-tagged job might require a yarrow-seeded challenge, while a falcon auditor checks whether each account produces distinct, verifiable results. Creating more identities does not multiply influence: each must lock additional capital and pass the same checks, so a sybil attacker pays upfront and risks losing the bond for every fraudulent identity.
